Document URL: https://js.langchain.com/docs/how_to/chatbots_retrieval/
Document content:

```
AIMessage {
  lc_serializable: true,
  lc_kwargs: {
    content: '"LangSmith LLM application testing and evaluation features"',
    tool_calls: [],
    invalid_tool_calls: [],
    additional_kwargs: { function_call: undefined, tool_calls: undefined },
    response_metadata: {}
  },
  lc_namespace: [ "langchain_core", "messages" ],
  content: '"LangSmith LLM application testing and evaluation features"',
  name: undefined,
  additional_kwargs: { function_call: undefined, tool_calls: undefined },
  response_metadata: {
    tokenUsage: { completionTokens: 11, promptTokens: 144, totalTokens: 155 },
    finish_reason: "stop"
  },
  tool_calls: [],
  invalid_tool_calls: []
}

```

Awesome! That transformed query would pull up context documents related to LLM application testing.

Let’s add this to our retrieval chain. We can wrap our retriever as follows:

```
import { RunnableBranch } from "@langchain/core/runnables";
import { StringOutputParser } from "@langchain/core/output_parsers";

const queryTransformingRetrieverChain = RunnableBranch.from([
  [
    (params: { messages: BaseMessage[] }) => params.messages.length === 1,
    RunnableSequence.from([parseRetrieverInput, retriever]),
  ],
  queryTransformPrompt.pipe(llm).pipe(new StringOutputParser()).pipe(retriever),
]).withConfig({ runName: "chat_retriever_chain" });

```

Then, we can use this query transformation chain to make our retrieval chain better able to handle such followup questions:

```
const conversationalRetrievalChain = RunnablePassthrough.assign({
  context: queryTransformingRetrieverChain,
}).assign({
  answer: documentChain,
});

```

Awesome! Let’s invoke this new chain with the same inputs as earlier:

```
await conversationalRetrievalChain.invoke({
  messages: [new HumanMessage("Can LangSmith help test my LLM applications?")],
});

```

Document Name: Langchain-JS
Document URL: https://js.langchain.com/docs/concepts/lcel
Document content:
## Should I use LCEL?​

LCEL is an orchestration solution \-- it allows LangChain to handle run-time execution of chains in an optimized way.

While we have seen users run chains with hundreds of steps in production, we generally recommend using LCEL for simpler orchestration tasks. When the application requires complex state management, branching, cycles or multiple agents, we recommend that users take advantage of LangGraph.

In LangGraph, users define graphs that specify the flow of the application. This allows users to keep using LCEL within individual nodes when LCEL is needed, while making it easy to define complex orchestration logic that is more readable and maintainable.

Here are some guidelines:

* If you are making a single LLM call, you don't need LCEL; instead call the underlying chat model directly.
* If you have a simple chain (e.g., prompt + llm + parser, simple retrieval set up etc.), LCEL is a reasonable fit, if you're taking advantage of the LCEL benefits.
* If you're building a complex chain (e.g., with branching, cycles, multiple agents, etc.) use LangGraph instead. Remember that you can always use LCEL within individual nodes in LangGraph.

____

Document Name: Langchain-JS
Document URL: https://js.langchain.com/docs/concepts/why_langchain
Document content:
## Standardized component interfaces​

LangChain provides common interfaces for components that are central to many AI applications. As an example, all chat models implement the BaseChatModel interface. This provides a standard way to interact with chat models, supporting important but often provider-specific features like tool calling and structured outputs.

### Example: chat models​

Many model providers support tool calling, a critical features for many applications (e.g., agents), that allows a developer to request model responses that match a particular schema. The APIs for each provider differ. LangChain's chat model interface provides a common way to bind tools to a model in order to support tool calling:

```
// Tool creation
const tools = [myTool];
// Tool binding
const modelWithTools = model.bindTools(tools);

```

Similarly, getting models to produce structured outputs is an extremely common use case. Providers support different approaches for this, including JSON mode or tool calling, with different APIs. LangChain's chat model interface provides a common way to produce structured outputs using the `withStructuredOutput()` method:

```
// Define tool as a Zod schema
const schema = z.object({ ... });
// Bind schema to model
const modelWithStructure = model.withStructuredOutput(schema)

```

### Example: retrievers​

In the context of RAG and LLM application components, LangChain's retriever interface provides a standard way to connect to many different types of data services or databases (e.g., vector stores or databases). The underlying implementation of the retriever depends on the type of data store or database you are connecting to, but all retrievers implement the runnable interface, meaning they can be invoked in a common manner.

```
const documents = await myRetriever.invoke("What is the meaning of life?");

```

```
[
   Document({
      pageContent: "The meaning of life is 42.",
      metadata: { ... },
   }),
   Document({
      pageContent: "The meaning of life is to use LangChain.",
      metadata: { ... },
   }),
   ...
]

```

# LangChain overview

Copy page

LangChain is an open source framework with a pre-built agent architecture and integrations for any model or tool — so you can build agents that adapt as fast as the ecosystem evolves

Copy page

LangChain is the easy way to start building completely custom agents and applications powered by LLMs. With under 10 lines of code, you can connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more. LangChain provides a pre-built agent architecture and model integrations to help you get started quickly and seamlessly incorporate LLMs into your agents and applications. 

**LangChain vs. LangGraph vs. Deep Agents**If you are looking to build an agent, we recommend you start with Deep Agents which comes “batteries-included”, with modern features like automatic compression of long conversations, a virtual filesystem, and subagent-spawning for managing and isolating context.Deep Agents are implementations of LangChain agents. If you don’t need these capabilities or would like to customize your own for your agents and autonomous applications, start with LangChain.Use LangGraph, our low-level agent orchestration framework and runtime, when you have more advanced needs that require a combination of deterministic and agentic workflows and heavy customization.

LangChain agents are built on top of LangGraph in order to provide durable execution, streaming, human-in-the-loop, persistence, and more. You do not need to know LangGraph for basic LangChain agent usage. We recommend you use LangChain if you want to quickly build agents and autonomous applications. 

____

Document content:
## 

​

 Create an agent

Copy

```
# pip install -qU langchain "langchain[anthropic]"
from langchain.agents import create_agent

def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
    """Get weather for a given city."""
    return f"It's always sunny in {city}!"

agent = create_agent(
    model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
    tools=[get_weather],
    system_prompt="You are a helpful assistant",
)

# Run the agent
agent.invoke(
    {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "what is the weather in sf"}]}
)

```

See the Installation instructions and Quickstart guide to get started building your own agents and applications with LangChain. 

Use LangSmith to trace requests, debug agent behavior, and evaluate outputs. Set `LANGSMITH_TRACING=true` and your API key to get started.

## Đánh giá nhanh

- **Điểm mạnh:** API đã sẵn để map thành tool (`get_activity_list`, `update_status`, `run_bayes`, `insert_record`, ...).
- **Thiếu hiện tại:** chưa thấy auth/permission layer cho API chatbot.
- **Rủi ro lớn:** `insert_record(table_name, data)` quá generic, nếu cho LLM gọi trực tiếp sẽ nguy hiểm (ghi nhầm bảng/cột, dữ liệu bẩn).

## Kiến trúc khuyến nghị

- **Orchestrator layer riêng** (không cho LLM gọi DB trực tiếp):
  1) Chat UI -> 2) Orchestrator (LangChain) -> 3) Tool functions đã whitelist -> 4) Backend API/CRUD.
- **Tool schema chặt** (Zod/Pydantic), ví dụ:
  - `update_activity_status(activity_id, status)`
  - `update_prior(activity_id, prob)` (validate 0..1)
  - `get_activity_list(user_id)`
  - `run_bayes(total_minute?)`
- **Write action có confirm 2 bước**:
  - LLM trả về “plan/action preview”
  - User bấm xác nhận rồi mới execute tool.

## Nên dùng LangChain Python hay LangChain-JS?

- Backend bạn là Python (`FastAPI` + `SQLAlchemy`) => **dễ nhất là LangChain Python** trong backend.
- Nếu muốn tích hợp theo stack web hiện tại (`React Router`), có thể dùng **LangChain-JS** ở server route/node layer rồi gọi FastAPI.
- Cả 2 đều ổn; theo repo này, **Python-first** thường triển khai nhanh và ít bridge hơn.

## MVP thực tế (ngắn gọn)

- Giai đoạn 1 (read-only): hỏi đáp + gọi tool đọc (`list/view/run_bayes`).
- Giai đoạn 2 (safe write): chỉ mở `update_status/update_prior` + confirm.
- Giai đoạn 3: mở rộng insert/update phức tạp + policy + audit log.

Nếu bạn muốn, mình có thể phác thảo luôn **tool contract cụ thể** (tên tool, input schema, guardrails, flow confirm) đúng theo các endpoint hiện có của `learningdb/backend`.

L3:## Mục tiêu
L4:
L5:- Dùng một lệnh `docker compose up --build` để khởi động đầy đủ 4 lớp: MySQL, backend API, LangChain orchestrator, frontend web.
L6:- Chạy theo **prod-like mode** (không hot reload).
L7:- Đảm bảo orchestrator dùng đúng backend nội bộ container và nhận API key từ `.env`.
L8:
L9:## Hiện trạng cần chỉnh
L10:
L11:- File compose hiện có `db`, `api`, `web` tại `[/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/compose.yml](/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/compose.yml)`, chưa có `orchestrator`.
L12:- `api` đang build từ `[/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/backend/Dockerfile](/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/backend/Dockerfile)`.
L13:- `web` đang build từ `[/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/Dockerfile](/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/Dockerfile)`, mới inject `VITE_API_BASE_URL`, chưa inject `VITE_ORCH_API_BASE_URL`.
L14:- Orchestrator hiện chạy từ package `learningdb/orchestrator`, phụ thuộc Python deps ở root `requirements.txt`.
L15:
L16:## Kiến trúc compose mục tiêu
L17:
L18:```mermaid
L19:flowchart LR
L20:  user[Browser] --> web[web:3000]
L21:  web --> apiPublic[api:8000]
L22:  web --> orchPublic[orchestrator:8100]
L23:  orchestrator[orchestrator:8100] --> apiInternal[api:8000]
L24:  apiInternal --> db[db:3306]
L25:```
L26:
L27:## Phase 1: Bổ sung service orchestrator vào compose
L28:
L29:- Thêm service `orchestrator` trong `[/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/compose.yml](/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/compose.yml)`:
L30:  - `build.context` dùng root repo để đọc `requirements.txt` và source orchestrator.
L31:  - `command`: chạy `uvicorn orchestrator.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8100` từ thư mục `learningdb`.
L32:  - `environment`:
L33:    - `ORCH_BACKEND_BASE_URL=http://api:8000/api`
L34:    - `ORCH_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, `ORCH_DEFAULT_MODEL`
L35:    - `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
L36:  - `depends_on`: chờ `api` healthy trước khi khởi động.
L37:  - expose `8100:8100`.
L38:
L39:## Phase 2: Dockerfile riêng cho orchestrator (prod-like)
L40:
L41:- Tạo Dockerfile mới (ví dụ `learningdb/orchestrator/Dockerfile`) để:
L42:  - copy `requirements.txt` từ root repo,
L43:  - `pip install -r requirements.txt`,
L44:  - copy thư mục `learningdb/` để import `orchestrator.*` đúng package path,
L45:  - default CMD chạy uvicorn orchestrator app.
L46:- Đảm bảo image dùng Python 3.12/3.13 để tránh lỗi `pydantic-core` đã gặp với 3.14.
L47:
L48:## Phase 3: Cập nhật web build args cho end-to-end
L49:
L50:- Cập nhật `[/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/Dockerfile](/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/Dockerfile)` và `compose.yml`:
L51:  - thêm `ARG/ENV VITE_ORCH_API_BASE_URL` (default `http://localhost:8100`),
L52:  - giữ `VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api` cho browser access.
L53:- Đảm bảo frontend service orchestrator (file `app/services/orchestrator.ts`) nhận đúng URL khi build trong container.
L54:
L55:## Phase 4: Healthcheck + startup ordering cứng
L56:
L57:- Bổ sung healthcheck cho `api` (`GET /api/health`) và `orchestrator` (`GET /health`).
L58:- Sửa `depends_on`:
L59:  - `api` phụ thuộc `db: service_healthy`
L60:  - `orchestrator` phụ thuộc `api: service_healthy`
L61:  - `web` phụ thuộc `api` và `orchestrator` (healthy hoặc started tùy mức chặt).
L62:- Mục tiêu: `docker compose up` không race condition khi app gọi orchestrator quá sớm.
L63:
L64:## Phase 5: Chuẩn hóa env + secret handling
L65:
L66:- Cập nhật `.env` mẫu (không commit secret) để có đủ biến cho 4 service:
L67:  - DB vars
L68:  - `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
L69:  - `ORCH_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, `ORCH_DEFAULT_MODEL`
L70:  - `VITE_API_BASE_URL`, `VITE_ORCH_API_BASE_URL` (nếu muốn override)
L71:- Bỏ comment inline cùng dòng API key để tránh parse sai giá trị.
L72:
L73:## Phase 6: Tài liệu vận hành 1 lệnh
L74:
L75:- Cập nhật `[/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/orchestrator/README.md](/Users/chibangnguyen/ayai/LearningDB/learningdb/orchestrator/README.md)` và/hoặc README root:
L76:  - lệnh chạy: `docker compose up --build`
L77:  - endpoint kiểm tra:
L78:    - `http://localhost:8000/api/health`
L79:    - `http://localhost:8100/health`
L80:    - `http://localhost:3000`
L81:  - cách dừng/reset volume db.
L82:
L83:## Phase 7: Verification checklist
L84:
L85:- `docker compose config` pass.
L86:- `db`, `api`, `orchestrator`, `web` đều healthy/running.
L87:- UI load được provider catalog từ orchestrator.
L88:- Chat flow thành công với provider đã cấu hình key.
L89:- Trường hợp thiếu key: orchestrator không crash, UI hiển thị unavailable đúng như thiết kế.
